title: Correcting Before Adapting: Gradient Correction for Federated Adaptive Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2502.02727v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Client-drift compensation methods mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity in federated learning (FL). While drift correction is well studied for stochastic gradient descent (SGD)-based FL, its interaction with adaptive client optimizers remains less understood. Adaptive optimizers such as Adam build each update from running averages of past gradients, so correcting only the final update direction leaves those averages, and the drift they contain, unchanged. We propose Federated Adaptive Gradient Correction ({\tt FA-GC}), which corrects each gradient before it enters these running averages, and compare it with Federated Adaptive Naive Tracking ({\tt FA-NT}), which adds the correction to the final direction. translated_title: 先校正再自适应：面向联邦自适应优化的梯度校正
translated_abstract: 客户端漂移补偿方法可以缓解联邦学习（FL）中数据异构性的影响。虽然针对基于随机梯度下降（SGD）的联邦学习，漂移校正已被广泛研究，但其与自适应客户端优化器之间的交互作用仍知之甚少。诸如Adam之类的自适应优化器是基于过去梯度的滑动平均来构建每次更新的，因此仅校正最终的更新方向会使这些滑动平均值（以及其中包含的漂移）保持不变。我们提出了联邦自适应梯度校正（FA-GC），它在每个梯度进入这些滑动平均之前对其进行校正，并将其与联邦自适应朴素跟踪（FA-NT）进行比较，后者是将校正项添加到最终方向上。我们证明，在没有梯度噪声的理想化设置下，FA-GC所遵循的方向仅会在全局目标的驻点处消失，而FA-NT所遵循的方向在其他位置也可能消失……
tldr: 提出FA-GC方法，在每个梯度进入自适应优化器的滑动平均之前先进行漂移校正，从而保证更新方向仅在全局目标的驻点处消失，优于仅在最终方向上补偿漂移的做法。
en_tdlr: Proposes FA-GC, which corrects client drift in each gradient before it enters the running averages of adaptive optimizers, ensuring the update direction vanishes only at stationary points of the global objective, unlike correcting only the final direction.
